raw_response: {"diagnosis": "gold_region_daily uses an inner join on customer_id, and batch 13 (and possibly other batches) delivers some customer_ids without zero-padding (e.g. 'C115', 'C91', 'C187') that never match the canonical 'C00001'-style keys in raw_customers, so those transactions are silently dropped. Normalizing the join key to the canonical form in gold_region_daily only should restore the missing rows without changing silver tables or output columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"gold_region_daily": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold_region_daily AS SELECT t.txn_date, c.region, count(*) AS n_txn, sum(t.amount) AS total FROM silver_transactions t JOIN silver_customers c ON c.customer_id = (CASE WHEN regexp_matches(t.customer_id, '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(t.customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE t.customer_id END) GROUP BY t.txn_date, c.region;"}}
